subject: ACME: procurement delay — MAP reshuffle & revised close plan
messages:
From: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: ACME — close timeline & MAP items (procurement delay)

Rishi / Karthik,

Quick heads-up from procurement: the legal procurement review hit a pause because our security team needs an updated SOC 2 evidence bundle and a short clarification on data retention for embeddings. They expect a one-week review cycle starting today. That pushes our internal procurement sign-off out by roughly 7 business days.

We know the original MAP had the final signature targeted for 2027-04-07. Given the review, we need to be realistic about the close date and the evaluation window.

Can Redwood: 
- Confirm you can deliver the SOC 2 artifact and the data retention spec by EOD tomorrow?
- Propose a condensed evaluation cadence (two short feature demos + light integration smoke test) that fits inside the procurement review?

Also, procurement asked whether any billing or onboarding milestones can be adjusted if the contract date shifts — they want to avoid double work.

Tom
Tom Sanders
Director, Cloud Solutions
ACME Corporation

[Attachment: procurement_qs.pdf (PDF, 52kb)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — close timeline & MAP items (procurement delay)

Tom — thanks for the flag and the detail. We can absolutely move quickly on the items you listed. High level response and next steps below.

1) SOC 2 / evidence bundle: Monica will attach the targeted SOC 2 extract (scope + evidence pointers) and a short note mapping the controls to your review checklist by tomorrow EOD.

2) Data retention spec for embeddings: Karthik has a concise spec (retention windows, optional TTL, and KMS integration notes). He'll attach that as well and is available for a 20-min call with procurement if useful.

3) Condensed evaluation cadence: proposing the following adjusted MAP milestones (attached as MAP_v2):
   - 2027-04-02: SOC 2 extract + data retention spec delivered (deliverable)
   - 2027-04-03: 30-min demo focusing on latency/cost profile + embedding export/import test
   - 2027-04-05: smoke integration test (sandbox) run by ACME with Redwood support
   - 2027-04-12: target contract signature (adjusted) — allows procurement review to complete

We tried to keep the evaluation condensed while preserving the gate that matters for your internal stakeholders (security + procurement). If procurement still needs the extra week, we'll treat 2027-04-19 as the fallback and add a canary rollout option to keep your launch on track.

I'll attach the updated MAP and the two supporting docs now. Let us know the preferred time for the 30-min demo tomorrow.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[rishi.malhotra@redwood.com]

[Attachments: map_v2.xlsx (Excel, 28kb), plan_summary.txt (TXT, 3kb)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 12:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — close timeline & MAP items (procurement delay)

Adding two items from the platform/legal side that will speed procurement sign-off: 

- I'll prepare a minimal contract redline pack that isolates the few clauses procurement typically asks about (data processing, retention, indemnity cap). If ACME can review those redlines while procurement does the SOC 2 verification, we can parallelize sign-off.

- We can offer a time-limited credit (one month of service credits) if the signature slips past 2027-04-12 to keep the commercial terms unchanged and demonstrate good faith.

If ACME is open to parallel review, please confirm who on your legal side should receive the redline pack. I'll send a DocuSign-ready version once we have a contact.

Karthik
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference

>

From: Tom Sanders <tom.sanders@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ACME — close timeline & MAP items (procurement delay)

Thanks Rishi / Karthik — this is helpful and actionable. Procurement asked me to confirm two things: 

1) Please send the SOC 2 extract and data retention spec to procurement@acme.com and legal@acme.com. They'll triage internally and loop in specific reviewers.

2) About the commercial ask: the buyer lead needs a written note that if the signature slips beyond 2027-04-12, Redwood will provide a one-month service credit and freeze the pricing for 90 days from the originally proposed signature date. Can you confirm in writing? If yes, procurement will proceed with parallel review (redlines + SOC 2).

If both items are confirmed, we should be able to keep the evaluation on the condensed cadence you suggested and target 2027-04-12 for signature. Appreciate the urgency and the credit offer — that helps us keep momentum.

Regards,
Tom
Director, Cloud Solutions, ACME Corporation

[Attachment: procurement_requirements_list.docx (DOCX, 14kb)]
